dict.string: Kasset.ai uses your microphone to record your side of a meeting and for dictation, and keeps recordings on this Mac.
Kasset.ai records the other participants' audio only while you record a meeting, and keeps it on this Mac.
Kasset.ai uses Screen & System Audio Recording only to hear the other participants of a meeting when System Audio Recording is unavailable. It never records your screen.
Kasset.ai reads your calendar to notify you about upcoming meetings and help identify speakers during transcription.
